title: Finite-free localization cone construction
statement: Let A be a commutative ring and M a complex as in the Lean declaration, with a finite unit-ideal generating family of localizations, m ≤ n, global cohomology vanishing above n, and each localization m-pseudo-coherent. Then there are E, N and a distinguished triangle E → M → N → E[1] such that E is m-pseudo-coherent and N has cohomology vanishing above n−1.

source.place: Tag 066D, proof, second and third paragraphs; Tags 064S, 00EO (2), 064R

proof.text: Unpack the finite-free approximation to show monotonicity: m-pseudo-coherent implies n-pseudo-coherent when m ≤ n. If m < n, the cohomology map at n is an isomorphism and hence an epimorphism. This is the proved private helper pseudoCoherent_mono.

For each localization, use IsLocalization.flat and Module.Flat.lTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap to show extension of scalars preserves monomorphisms; its preservation of cokernels implies preservation of homology. Transport the global vanishing hypothesis with mapHomologyIso and homologyFunctorFactors. Apply finite_homology_of_isMPseudoCoherent to the localized complex at n and transport finiteness through these isomorphisms and LocalizedModule.equivTensorProduct. Finally apply Module.Finite.of_localizationSpan to obtain finite generation of M.homology n. All transports and the descent are proved in finite_top_of_local.

Use Module.Finite.exists_fin' to choose a surjection from a finite free module onto M.homology n. Lift it through M.homologyπ n by Projective.factorThru. Define E as the single complex in degree n on this free module and define its chain map a into M by mkHomFromSingle using the lift into cycles. Prove its strict upper and lower bounds and termwise finite freeness. The cycles/homology naturality equations identify the composite on degree-n homology with the chosen surjection, so the induced homology map is epi. This construction is the proved private helper exists_top_approximation; it uses only proved Mathlib results.

Define N explicitly as CochainComplex.mappingCone a and take its image triangle under Q; mappingCone_triangle_distinguished proves it distinguished. E is m-pseudo-coherent with itself and the identity as witness. For j > n-1, E has zero cohomology at j+1. At j=n, the epimorphism on top cohomology makes the second map zero by HomologySequence.epi_homologyMap_mor₁_iff; at j>n its source is zero by hypothesis. HomologySequence.exact₃ then implies the cone cohomology at j is zero.

lean.statement: theorem localization_cone_construction {A : Type u₁} [CommRing A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w₁} (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A)] (M : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) ℤ) (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A) [∀ i : Fin r, HasDerivedCategory.{w₂} (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} (Localization.Away (f i)))] (hf : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = ⊤) (m n : ℤ) (hmn : m ≤ n) (hvan : ∀ j : ℤ, n < j → IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) j).obj (Q.obj M))) (hlocal : ∀ i : Fin r, IsMPseudoCoherent m (Q.obj ((Functor.mapHomologicalComplex (ModuleCat.extendScalars (algebraMap A (Localization.Away (f i)))) (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj M))) : ∃ (E N : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) ℤ) (a : Q.obj E ⟶ Q.obj M) (b : Q.obj M ⟶ Q.obj N) (c : Q.obj N ⟶ (Q.obj E)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧), Triangle.mk a b c ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A)) ∧ IsMPseudoCoherent m (Q.obj E) ∧ (∀ j : ℤ, n - 1 < j → IsZero ((homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max u₁ v₁} A) j).obj (Q.obj N)))
